items.title: Anthropic's long-term leadership in AI looks 'extremely strong': Fmr. Cisco CEO
items.summary:
JC2 Ventures founder and CEO John Chambers sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss Anthropic's (ANTH.PVT) amended prospectus and what that could indicate about the company's leadership in the space, while also commenting on what a "trainwreck" company in the AI ecosystem looks like.

Chambers was executive chairman and CEO of Cisco Systems (CSCO).
